marie_advice.text: It is easy to disappear into thought when the physical world feels demanding. Hours pass, meals get skipped, messages go unanswered, and the day becomes difficult to reenter. Give yourself something solid to return to: water, food, a shower, a walk, another person's voice. Come back before the distance starts feeling normal.
